about: A CUPS raster sync word counts only with a NUL in the 64-byte MediaClass field after it, so text starting with the same four letters stays out of --purge. Run: mutate-on-target.py TREE spoolaudit/classify.py tests/test_spool_audit_classify.py tests/mutants/jpt-raster-nul-on-classify.json

mutants.name: the sync word alone
edits:
return (f.head[:4] in RASTER_SYNC
            and "\x00" in f.head[4:4 + RASTER_MEDIA_CLASS])
mutants.target: text starting with a sync word is not raster

mutants.name: a NUL anywhere in the head
mutants.target: a sync word with no NUL in the 64 bytes after it is not raster

mutants.name: no raster rule
edits:
return (f.head[:4] in RASTER_SYNC
            and "\x00" in f.head[4:4 + RASTER_MEDIA_CLASS])
